data.description: Accepts a device serial number from the event and attempts to restore MDM control by redeploying the management framework and forcing a check-in, then re-checks compliance. If the device is still non-compliant, it is quarantined and locked, and an analyst is asked to approve before any wipe. A note is added on every outcome. Computers only.

advanced.note: Asks an analyst to approve wiping the computer. Times out after 30 minutes.

data.message: Device is still reported NON_COMPLIANT after automated correction. Quarantine and lock were QUEUED (lock is an async MDM command — queued, not confirmed applied). Approve device WIPE? This ERASES the device and is IRREVERSIBLE.

19.userCode:
rows = phantom.collect2(container=container, datapath=["wipe_device:action_result.status", "wipe_device:action_result.message", "wipe_device:action_result.parameter.device_id"], action_results=results)
    outcomes = [(r[2], r[0], r[1]) for r in rows if r] or [(None, None, "no wipe result was returned")]
    failed = [o for o in outcomes if o[1] != "success"]

    if not failed:
        phantom.add_note(
              container=container,
              title="Compliance drift - ERASE command queued",
              content=(
                  "An ERASE_DEVICE MDM command was QUEUED for the device (not a confirmed erase). "
                  "The device wipes on its next check-in. "
              ),
              note_type="general",
          )
    else:
        lines = ["- device {}: {} ({})".format(d, s, m) for d, s, m in outcomes]
        phantom.add_note(
              container=container,
              title="Compliance drift - ERASE command NOT queued",
              content=(
                  "The wipe action returned an error - the ERASE command was NOT queued for every device. "
                  "The device is still quarantined + locked. Manual intervention required.\n"
                  + "\n".join(lines)
              ),
              note_type="general",
          )

data.notes:
Inputs: computer serial number (artifact cef.serialNumber)
Interactions: Jamf Pro
Actions: get device by serial, redeploy management framework, send blank push, get compliance status, add to static group, lock device, wipe device (after analyst approval)
Outputs: notes on the event
Before use: a Jamf Pro asset named jamf_pro (or change the asset on every action block); replace <your-quarantine-group>, the lock PIN <your-6-digit-pin>, <your-return-message> and <your-callback-number>. The wipe prompt goes to the Administrator role; change it to your approver role.
